translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.86:1: By the heaven and the nightly star
verses.86:2: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is
verses.86:3: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness
verses.86:4: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺
verses.86:5: Let people then consider what they were created from
verses.86:6: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid
verses.86:7: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage
verses.86:8: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺
verses.86:9: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed
verses.86:10: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper
verses.86:11: By the sky with its recurring cycles
verses.86:12: and the earth with its sprouting plants
verses.86:13: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word
verses.86:14: and is not to be taken lightly
verses.86:17: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while
